See `docs/MANUAL_TEST_PLAN.md`."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Storage layout"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Two tables plus a schema-version table, all under `MYSQL_TABLE_PREFIX`:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- `${prefix}sessions` — one row per materialized session (the `SessionHeader`).
- `${prefix}events` "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"— the append-only event log; `PRIMARY KEY (session_id, seq)`.
- `${prefix}_meta` — applied schema ve"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"append-only event log; `PRIMARY KEY (session_id, seq)`.
- `${prefix}_meta` — applied schema version."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The header row is written **only in the same transaction as the first event batch** (lazy materializ"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ation, atomic), so a created-but-never-appended session leaves no rows and is absent from `list`."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Read/write split"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Write hooks (`appendBatch`, `commitRepair`) use the write pool; read hooks (`loadStored`, `readStore"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"dRevision`, `loadStoredFrom`, `list`, `listSnapshots`) use the read pool. When `MYSQL_READ_HOST` is "},{"id":"p23s3","text":"unset the read pool reuses the write connection (same-store mode — what tests exercise). Read-replic"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"a lag does not break the seam contract: revisions only need to be stable while unchanged."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Durability and crash semantics"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- **Transactional append.** Each batch commits in a single InnoDB transaction; the log is append-onl"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"y and seq-contiguous. The composite primary key is the cross-process safety net for same-id double w"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"rites (the second writer is rejected on a key collision).

- **`list()` is unpaginated and unfiltered** (seam constraint).
- **Cross-process lease mo"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"de is single-primary only (TD-008)** — the opt-in `cluster.lease` mode serializes writers through a "},{"id":"p27s4","text":"`leases` row and fences every `append`; it assumes all lease traffic reaches one write primary (`wri"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"tePool`). A dedicated lease-primary connection for multi-primary / read-split topologies, and reclam"},{"id":"p27s6","text":"ation of released or expired lease rows, are deferred. Both need a global monotonic fence sequence i"},{"id":"p27s7","text":"nstead of the current per-row `fence_token + 1`, which is only safe because released rows are kept ("},{"id":"p27s8","text":"never deleted).
- **Plaintext by default** — session events may contain sensitive content (conversat"},{"id":"p27s9","text":"ions, tool results, request headers). `ENCRYPTION_KEY` is a reserved extension point; application-le"},{"id":"p27s10","text":"vel field encryption is deferred. Deployers should consider MySQL native TDE / at-rest encryption.
